scope: Backend-only digital native source editing and flexible circuit input preservation.
user_outcome: A supplied native KiCad board can be retained, edited through bounded SDK/API/AI actions, reviewed, rechecked at the exact edited revision, and exported with its original project/rule bytes.
connected_workflow: Upload native source files into a project with content hashes.
Select one project stem and promote exact registered bytes into retained editable artifacts.
Propose bounded native edits without recompiling supplied geometry.
Run native before/after checks with the retained same-stem .kicad_pro/.kicad_dru files.
Review a stable pending proposal; acceptance validates primary and companion hashes.
Run DRC/ERC against the selected retained edited or historical revision.
Download a deterministic native ZIP with preserved rules and a hash manifest.

ai_connection.native_edit_receipt: Immutable action/source-bound receipt; execution does not advance and stale the candidate review.
ai_connection.checks: run_drc/run_erc prefer the exact pinned retained design; inspect_registered_sources retains original-upload semantics.

downstream_changes: Inherited passed/running canonical verifications become blocked; mechanical fit, wiring, materials, firmware, 3D and manufacturing outputs are marked for recheck.
generic_compiler: Preserves explicit references, pad IDs and named/singleton nets. Unknown module IDs remain visible failures; synthetic physical package geometry is labeled logical preview and blocks fabrication.
remaining_limits: Moving a footprint does not reconnect or reroute its old copper automatically.
This native import path does not close hierarchical schematic or external library dependencies.
Unknown physical packages require exact source geometry and electrical contracts before fabrication.
Downstream enclosure, firmware and material changes require explicit engineering/rechecks; source edits do not regenerate them automatically.
No owned hardware, physical test, procurement or operational approval is represented.
